decision_basis: 4-1BBL/TNFRSF9 structural complex evidence plus TRAF/NF-kappaB/ERK pathway and T-cell functional assays support the exact receptor-proximal relay.
VEGF-A/FLT1 binding and receptor phosphorylation, together with endothelial migration/angiogenic function and downstream PI3K-AKT/FAK evidence, support the exact relay/function record.
Mature VEGF-C/FLT4 binding and receptor phosphorylation plus ERK/PI3K-AKT and lymphatic endothelial function support the exact relay/function record.
Mature VEGF-D binding and activation of KDR/VEGFR2 plus downstream endothelial signaling/function support the exact receptor-proximal relay.
